prevention_rule: Before quoting any converged flow result, run an integral conservation check (energy/heat/circulation budget) that tends to zero under refinement.
rationale: The plan has no PDE/CFD flow solver (stream-function/vorticity); the model is a lumped lip valve plus 14 one-pole modes and a 1-D simple-wave warp, so the trigger cannot arise.

prevention_rule: When a model defines more than one reference for the same unit, every fixture using that unit must declare which reference it used, and a cheap test must assert the declaration before value-level tests.
rationale: Trigger can arise: cents/pitch units have several references here (written vs concert pitch = +2; A4=440 vs the tuning parameter; natural_dev_cents = harmonic-series deviation hs_dev plus state-vs-open difference, relative to ET(written-2)). The fingering fixture header declares 'written pitch', D-004 defines the formula in prose and T-014 uses EXPECTED values, so the risk is partly covered, but resonators_valid.json (provenance only a note) and the table JSON carry no reference declaration and no test asserts one.
amendment: DECISIONS.md D-004 (JSON layout): add to the table 'provenance' object (and generate_table output) a required field 'cents_reference' = '12-TET, A4=440 Hz, concert pitch = written-2; natural_dev_cents = hs_dev + (dev(state)-dev(open))'. S-005/S-006: make ResonatorTable::fromJson (and T-030 equivalent check in a non-frozen unit test added by implementer) reject a table missing it; write the one-line convention into the header comment of ResonatorTable.h NoteEntry (additive, comment only).

prevention_rule: Before a plan states an equivalence level, block size or performance multiple as a requirement, run a spike that measures it on the real engine and cite the spike output next to the number; until then label it 'unmeasured default'.
rationale: A-012 (RTF <= 0.05 at 48 kHz/128, on a CI runner) is an intake default adopted as a frozen perf test (T-024b) and SC-7. The only evidence is a reasoned flop estimate 'RTF about 0.01-0.03' (round-1.md 2.7); no spike timed the engine (no timing file in research/spikes), and the claim is not labelled 'unmeasured default'. D-006's bitwise block-partition independence (T-023) is by design, not spiked. DR-PERF provides workarounds and the human can decide, so the gap degrades rather than blocks; but T-024 'never relax' could leave a frozen test unsatisfiable.
amendment: ASSUMPTIONS.md A-012 and TRACEABILITY SC-7: append '(unmeasured default; estimate only, premortem/round-1.md 2.7)'. PLAN.md S-008 Done-when: after tpt_operational_tests pass, build Release and run `ctest -L perf` once locally, writing the RTF to logs/S-008-rtf.txt (early warning before S-017); if RTF > 0.03 apply DR-PERF items (1)-(2) then, not at S-017.

prevention_rule: On the first push failure read the error text; if it names the proxy/authorized repository set, do not request or retry with tokens: ask the human to attach the repository or switch to a manual-upload workflow.
plan_refs: PLAN S-000 action 3 (git push --dry-run, gh api permissions)
rationale: S-000 probes push access up front (dry-run, gh api permissions.push), which would catch an unauthorised repository early, but DR-CRED treats every 401/403 as a token problem and tells the implementer to write BLOCKED.md 'asking for a new credential via GH_TOKEN'. A proxy 'repository not in this session's authorized repository set' message is independent of the token, so the plan would again send the human off to mint tokens, and has no manual-upload fallback for impl branch pushes (S-KNOW has only a git bundle).
amendment: DECISIONS.md DR-CRED: add a branch 'If the error text contains 'proxy', 'authorized repository set' or 'access to this repository is not enabled for this session', the cause is repository authorisation, not the token: do not ask for or try any token; BLOCKED.md asks the human to attach/authorise qualitycoding/trumpet-vst (and knowledge, Lessons for S-KNOW) to the session, or to accept a manual upload: ship a zip mirroring repo paths plus UPLOAD.md (target branch; each path add/overwrite/delete) and verify afterwards with git fetch and tree-hash comparison.' Mirror the one-liner in S-000 'On failure'.

prevention_rule: For a regularised interface, tie the regularisation width to the mesh and show band independence before reporting a limit.
rationale: No mesh-refined regularised phase-change/interface model exists in the plan (no spatial discretisation).

prevention_rule: After any change made to improve convergence, rerun one case without the change (or stiffer) and require integral functionals to agree.
rationale: The trigger is a stiff coupled PDE iteration stabilised by widening a band or adding damping; the plan has no such iterative solver (the closed-form implicit flow and secant fscale calibration are not stabilised by widening/damping).

prevention_rule: When a frozen test fails, never edit the test file or regenerate the hash manifest; log the diagnosis and halt for a human ruling, unless the change is compile-only.
rationale: The plan forbids modifying/skipping frozen tests and routes disputes to TEST_CHALLENGE.md, which is the core of the rule. But tests/FROZEN_MANIFEST.sha256 is itself not in the manifest (0 self-references; 32 lines) and not named in the immutability rule, verify_freeze.sh only checks files against the manifest on the same branch, and neither the freeze CI job nor any step diffs tests/ against the plan commit. An implementer could edit a test and regenerate the manifest and 'freeze OK' would still print, exactly the lesson's failure; nothing would flag it.
amendment: HANDOFF.md Immutability rule: add 'Never edit tests/FROZEN_MANIFEST.sha256, research/spikes/expected_values.py or any frozen file, and never regenerate the manifest; only the planning agent amends them (protocol 2E.4).' PLAN.md S-002 (ci.yml) and D-020 `freeze` job: add a step `git fetch origin gen-20261007T145241Z-trumpet-vst-plan && git diff --exit-code FETCH_HEAD -- tests research/spikes/expected_values.py` (amended by the planning agent's new head when an amendment is applied). S-000: run the same diff once and record it.

prevention_rule: Count distinct publishers (not URLs) when assigning 'corroborated'; same-vendor pages count as one; add the count to the claim record and have a consistency check compare it with the label.

C-015 (two files of the same Tracktion/pluginval v1.0.4 repository) is corroborated on a single publisher and is load-bearing; C-026 and C-029 are made 'corroborated' in build_claims.py by hard-coded appending of the plan owner's own sibling project report (not independent) while their text says 'inference' / 'could not be confirmed'. C-046/C-047/C-050 use two papers on hal.science (different papers, arguably fine). The affected facts (pluginval invocation, auval, xvfb) were verified empirically by the plan-verify CI run, so impact is on label honesty only.
amendment: research/spikes/build_claims.py (or schema_check.py): add a check that groups sources by registrable domain plus repository owner/org and fails/downgrades any 'corroborated' claim with fewer than two distinct publishers; downgrade C-015, C-026 and C-029 to 'verified' (cite plan-verify run 37748754510) or 'single-source'; add field 'distinct_publishers' to claims.json.

prevention_rule: Every stochastic stage needs a test that its output power in each band equals the intended power (computed independently).
plan_refs: D-012 Breath noise (xorshift32 w = x/2^31-1, 3 kHz one-pole, 0.002*breathNoise*pm/pth*w)
rationale: The trumpet has a stochastic stage (D-012 breath noise: a uniform generator with std 1/sqrt(3), filtered, rate-dependent via the internal rate and decimator). No frozen test measures its band power; T-034/T-023 only check lock, sustain, finiteness and bounds, so a missing 1.732 factor or sample-rate normalisation would pass every test. G-005 listening is the only other check (demo 09 targets crackle at brightness, not noise level).
amendment: PLAN.md S-008 (and Done-when): add a non-frozen implementer test (new file, e.g. core tests_extra, registered in tests/CMake outside the manifest) that renders breathNoise=1 with the pressure held and lips/modes muted (or differences vs breathNoise=0), and asserts the noise power in 3 bands (e.g. 0.3-1, 1-3, 3-8 kHz) equals the analytic value from D-012 (state the uniform std 1/sqrt(3) and the 3 kHz one-pole gain) within 1 dB at 44.1, 48 and 96 kHz. prevention_rule: Measure pitch-invariance of a nonlinear voice at the nonlinearity's output (harmonic levels relative to the fundamental), separately from fixed-frequency stages after it; never use whole-chain brightness as the invariant.
rationale: The plan has no pitch-invariance-of-timbre criterion: T-029 compares each note against the real recording of the same pitch, using harmonic levels relative to the strongest harmonic (D-017) and a centroid ratio vs the reference at that pitch, and T-021/T-022 compare dynamics at fixed pitch; no test infers voice character across pitch from whole-chain brightness.

prevention_rule: In a setup script run apt-get update || echo warning before the first install, then verify each required package with dpkg -s.
plan_refs: CI plugin job (plan-verify.yml lines 25-26: sudo apt-get update then install under bash -e)
rationale: The no-sudo variant avoids apt entirely, but the sudo variant is two plain lines (update, then install) with no tolerance for an update failing on an unrelated repository and no dpkg -s check; if sudo exists in the implementer sandbox with egress limits, the same abort can occur. CI runners are not affected in practice.
amendment: plan/ENVIRONMENT.md sudo block: write 'sudo apt-get update || echo "warning: apt-get update failed"' then the install with --no-install-recommends, followed by a loop `for p in <packages>; do dpkg -s $p >/dev/null || echo MISSING $p; done`; on a missing package fall back to the no-sudo variant and log it. Same change for the ci.yml Linux packages step.

prevention_rule: Test helpers that contain an algorithm must state their precondition, avoid silent defaults, and be tested on a hand-checkable synthetic case before the test is frozen.

prevention_rule: Before diagnosing a git credential failure print the names of GIT_*, GH_* and GITHUB_* variables and retry with them unset and an explicit askpass helper before concluding the token is bad.

DR-CRED treats any 401/403 as a revoked or bad token: finish the step, write BLOCKED.md asking for a new credential and end the session, with no diagnostic of ambient GIT_CONFIG_*/GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN overrides, so the human may be asked for a new credential needlessly and the run stops.
